name: gemini-notebook-mcp
description: Connect Claude to Gemini Notebook. Create podcasts, research topics, generate quizzes, flashcards, mind maps, and more from your notebooks.
long_description:
This extension connects Claude Desktop to Gemini Notebook via the Model Context Protocol. It provides 53 tools for managing notebooks, sources, labels, chat sessions, research, sharing, usage, and generated content, including interactive reports.

**Prerequisites:**
1. Install the package: `uv tool install git+https://github.com/neo-cod3/gemini-notebook-mcp-cli-fork`
2. Authenticate: Run `nlm login` to set up your Google account

**Features:**
- Create and manage notebooks
- Add sources (URLs, YouTube, Google Drive, text, files)
- Generate podcasts (Audio Overview)
- Create quizzes, flashcards, mind maps, reports, and interactive reports
- Research topics with web or Drive search
